5 C-Suite Actions No signal this month —
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENTS Korea seeks investment in
Viral safety testing and cell bank (MCB/WCB) characterization
On August 20, 2026, Charles River Laboratories partnered with Medigen Vaccine Biologics Corp. to
characterize and validate the virus seed bank for MVC's next-generation multivalent enterovirus vaccine. The
companies will leverage advanced analytical platforms including Next-Generation Sequencing to accelerate
high-quality vaccine development and support global regulatory readiness.

BUSINESS DEVELOPMENTS Korea seeks investment in
Electric motors and high-power battery modules for aircraft
Boeing has signed definitive agreements to transfer its Wisk Aero, SkyGrid, and Insitu subsidiaries to Archer
Aviation. Under the transaction, Boeing will take a stake in Archer and establish an ongoing collaboration and
technology-sharing arrangement. The partnership combines Wisk's pioneering eVTOL and autonomy
technologies with Archer's platform to advance the aerospace and defense sector.
Source Press release · Boeing - News Releases and Statements / Press Releases / Statements 2026.08.10

2 Production Expansion & Geographical Diversification
Ouster is expanding its LiDAR production capacity to support rising demand, with its
production run rate expected to increase from approximately 40,000 units annually toward
100,000 units.
Source Yahoo Finance 2026.08.17
3 Capital Raising & Securing Liquidity No signal this month —
4 Tech Ecosystem Partnerships (R&D) No signal this month —
5 C-Suite Actions No signal this month —
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENTS Korea seeks investment in LiDAR for robots
Ouster launched Rev8, the world's first native color LiDAR sensor, in the second quarter of 2026. Customer
adoption was reflected in several orders exceeding $1 million from major industry leaders, including the world's
largest heavy machinery manufacturer. In addition, the company secured a significant contract with the Utah
Department of Transportation for its largest LiDAR deployment to cover several hundred intersections across
the state.
Source Yahoo Finance 2026.08.17

Nexeon
Battery anode materials UK
1 Supply Chain & Geopolitical Risk No signal this month —
2 Production Expansion & Geographical Diversification No signal this month —
3 Capital Raising & Securing Liquidity
Completion of £100 Million Investment Round.
— The completion of the £100 million ($133 million) investment round includes a £52.6 million
($70 million) commitment from the National Wealth Fund along with new investors Korea
Development Bank and Honda Xcelerator Ventures, supporting continued scale-up and
commercialisation activities.
Source Nexeon - Media / Newsroom 2026.08.31
4 Tech Ecosystem Partnerships (R&D) No signal this month —
5 C-Suite Actions No signal this month —
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENTS Korea seeks investment in Silicon-carbon (Si-C) anode materials
Nexeon has completed its latest investment round totalling £100 million ($133 million), backed by the National
Wealth Fund, Korea Development Bank, and Honda Xcelerator Ventures. The funding will support the
development of a UK-based pilot manufacturing facility and the expansion of its advanced manufacturing
technology unit. Additionally, Nexeon recently brought online the world's first volume production facility for
silicon-carbon materials in Gunsan, South Korea.
Source Nexeon - Media / Newsroom 2026.08.31

P R O D U C T D E V E L O P M E N T S · 1/1
Business Developments by Product
CompanieswithnoinvestmentsignalthismonthbutwithAugustnewsontheproductKoreaseeksfromthem.Cardsmarked"General
company news" cover the company's main business instead. Any of these could turn into an investment signal.
Albemarle
Battery cathode materials USA
Korea seeks investment in Lithium hydroxide and lithium carbonate for cathodes
Developments in August
Albemarle reported $1.3 billion in Energy Storage net sales and 65 kilotons LCE in sales volume for the second
quarter of 2026. Increased output from the Wodgina mine partially offset the delay in the Talison CGP3 ramp due
to a fire, with full-year sales volumes expected to range between 225 and 235 kilotons LCE.
Source Albemarle - Newsroom / News 2026.08.05
